newsitem.title: GERMANY: Strong 95/96 growth at Deutsche funds unit DWS.
newsitem.headline: Strong 95/96 growth at Deutsche funds unit DWS.

text.p: The fund investment arm of Deutsche Bank AG, DWS, paid out around 1.65 billion marks to investors in its various investment funds in the year to the end of September, the DWS said on Friday.
The pay-out on most of the fund management group's bond-backed funds stayed at around the same levels as the previous year, despite falling interest rates, DWS said.
The DWS added that the pay-out on equity funds was also around last year's level.
DWS said that its bond-backed funds increased in value by between 9.3 percent and 17.5 percent over the year, with its funds for convertible bonds registering the highest growth in value.

The majority of DWS equity funds registered double-digit growth in value, with particularly good performance coming from its Top 50 Europa fund, which was launched on May 20, 1996 and consists of stocks based on the principle of shareholder value.
The value of the Top 50 Europa fund grew 32.4 percent during the year, while the DSW Scandinavia fund and DSW Energy fund both grew more than 30 percent in the year.
